customer: hey so im leasing a compact sedan thru Bluewater Leasing and want to upgrade to somthing bigger. can northwind buy out my lease or do i have to deal with it myself?? im in texas if that matters
agent: Thanks for reaching out! According to our article "Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts," Bluewater Leasing allows us to buy out your lease only if you also buy a car from Northwind, so that could work well since you're looking to upgrade to something bigger. If you'd rather not go that route, you can buy the car out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease (see "Selling vs. turning in at lease end").
